import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict

import requests


OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"


def moderate_text(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    api_key = os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV)
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing OPENAI_API_KEY")
    response = requests.post(
        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        data=json.dumps({"model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, "input": text}),
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    payload = response.json()
    result = payload["results"][0]
    categories = result.get("categories", {})
    category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {})
    flagged = bool(result.get("flagged", False))
    score = max(category_scores.values(), default=0.0)
    return {
        "flagged": flagged,
        "score": score,
        "categories": categories,
        "category_scores": category_scores,
        "raw": payload,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    text = sys.stdin.read()
    print(json.dumps(moderate_text(text), ensure_ascii=False))

+

+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
+OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_batch(messages: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_key = os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV)
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps({"model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, "input": messages}),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    results = payload.get("results", [])
+    decisions: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for index, message in enumerate(messages):
+        result = results[index] if index < len(results) else {}
+        categories = result.get("categories", {})
+        category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {})
+        flagged = bool(result.get("flagged", False))
+        score = max(category_scores.values(), default=0.0)
+        decisions.append(
+            {
+                "message": message,
+                "flagged": flagged,
+                "score": score,
+                "categories": categories,
+                "category_scores": category_scores,
+            }
+        )
+    return decisions
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
+    messages = json.loads(input_data) if input_data else []
+    print(json.dumps(moderate_batch(messages), ensure_ascii=False))
